amendments.body: `enforce_invariants` now repairs shrimp egg bookkeeping on every simulation step by calling `reconcile_egg_cohort_counts()` (`crates/tank_core/src/invariants.rs:42-48`; `crates/tank_core/src/engine.rs:789-794`). When `berried_females_count` is larger than the cohort sum, that helper fabricates a new `EggCohort` at the current `egg_progress_days` (`crates/tank_core/src/types/biology.rs:600-620`), and the new validation test explicitly blesses that behavior (`crates/tank_core/tests/validation.rs:263-300`). This means a transient bookkeeping bug or partially migrated state can silently create near-hatching clutches instead of surfacing an invariant violation, which changes live simulation outcomes and can duplicate births. Please keep this kind of repair at load/migration boundaries only, or fail runtime invariant enforcement on mismatches instead of synthesizing eggs.
amendments.rationale: This is a correctness issue in the live simulator, not just a test gap: invalid state is turned into new biological state.

amendments.body: The new e2e suite introduces multiple `medium_planted` runs with the same seed (`crates/tank_harness/tests/e2e_baseline_scenarios.rs:245-247`, `crates/tank_harness/tests/e2e_baseline_scenarios.rs:778-780`, `crates/tank_harness/tests/e2e_baseline_scenarios.rs:833-860`), but `HarnessRun::artifact_dir()` keys failure artifacts only by `scenario_id` and seed (`crates/tank_harness/src/lib.rs:546-553`). In a failing or parallel run, those tests all write to the same `/tmp/tank_harness/medium_planted_seed42` directory and can overwrite each other’s `trace.jsonl`, ledger, and metadata. Because `from_state()` still records the maintained variant as plain `medium_planted` (`crates/tank_harness/src/lib.rs:408-419`), the surviving artifact is also ambiguous. Give each harness run an explicit artifact/test label and include it in the artifact path/metadata.
amendments.rationale: The patch promises CI-friendly failure artifacts, but the new tests make artifact capture nondeterministic and hard to debug.

amendments.body: `maintained_medium_variant_reaches_reproduction_window` is presented as a reproduction guardrail, but it is not actually baselining current scenario behavior: it manually boosts periphyton, adult reserve, and reproductive readiness, then disables shrimp mortality entirely (`crates/tank_harness/tests/e2e_baseline_scenarios.rs:849-858`). That means the test can still pass after regressions in the real survival/stress model, because adults are prevented from dying and start with artificial hidden-state headroom. If reproduction needs its own envelope, it should be a named scenario/fixture built from public startup parameters with normal mortality semantics left on.
amendments.rationale: As written, this test weakens the scientific regression harness by checking an engineered happy path instead of the actual modeled behavior.

payload.summary: Reviewed the cumulative `tanksim-6e5.1.3` range (`4920312..2441e76`) in a detached worktree; the targeted tests pass there, but I found three substantive issues: runtime invariant repair now fabricates egg cohorts, the new harness artifacts collide across same-seed scenario tests, and the reproduction envelope relies on an ad hoc no-mortality setup rather than real scenario behavior.
